decode_counter_definitions.stdlib_json_loads: Successful json.loads calls only; excludes Pydantic and pydantic-core JSON parsing.
decode_counter_definitions.typed_fact_json_decodes: Successful Fact.model_validate_json calls, including Store.fact/facts and other actual typed validations; repeated cache hits do not count.
decode_counter_definitions.raw_fact_json_decodes: Successful pydantic-core from_json calls on same-snapshot stored raw fact bytes.
decode_counter_definitions.calculation_result_json_decodes: Successful json.loads calls matching the byte length and SHA256 of calculation.outcome returned by instrumented SQL; raw outcomes are not retained, and results from other sources are outside this count.
decode_counter_definitions.adoption_accounting_slice_reads: Successful close_storage.read_accounting calls; nested adopted rows are counted separately and a QueryReads cache hit does not count.
decode_counter_definitions.adoption_section_reads: Successful close_storage.read_section calls for adopted_results; may overlap a full-manifest read.
decode_counter_definitions.full_close_manifest_decodes: Successful close_storage.decode_close calls; overlap with its section reads and must not be added to them.
decode_counter_definitions.material_original_parses: Successful materials.inspect_bytes calls on original bytes; successful inspection-cache hits do not count.

WITH requests AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT json_extract(value,'$[0]') AS slot,json_extract(value,'$[1]') AS kind,json_extract(value,'$[2]') AS key,json_extract(value,'$[3]') AS cutoff FROM json_each(?)), ids AS (SELECT q.slot,c.id FROM requests q CROSS JOIN calculation c ON c.id=substr(q.key,2) CROSS JOIN calculation_seal z ON z.calculation_id=c.id WHERE substr(q.key,1,1)='#' AND (q.kind='*' OR q.kind=c.kind) AND c.period<q.cutoff UNION ALL SELECT q.slot,c.id FROM requests q CROSS JOIN calculation c ON c.kind=q.kind CROSS JOIN calculation_current a ON a.calculation_id=c.id WHERE q.key='*' AND c.period<q.cutoff UNION ALL SELECT q.slot,c.id FROM requests q CROSS JOIN calculation_scope x ON x.kind=q.kind AND x.scope_key=q.key CROSS JOIN calculation_current a ON a.calculation_id=x.calculation_id CROSS JOIN calculation c ON c.id=a.calculation_id WHERE q.key<>'*' AND substr(q.key,1,1)<>'#' AND q.kind<>'*' AND c.period<q.cutoff UNION ALL SELECT q.slot,c.id FROM requests q CROSS JOIN calculation_scope x ON x.scope_key=q.key CROSS JOIN calculation_current a ON a.calculation_id=x.calculation_id CROSS JOIN calculation c ON c.id=a.calculation_id WHERE q.key<>'*' AND substr(q.key,1,1)<>'#' AND q.kind='*' AND c.period<q.cutoff) SELECT ids.slot,c.* FROM ids CROSS JOIN calculation c ON c.id=ids.id ORDER BY ids.slot,c.period,c.subject_id

OR v.close_period IS NULL) THEN coalesce(current_publication.calculation_id,v.calculation_id) ELSE v.calculation_id END AS basis_calculation_id FROM candidates v LEFT JOIN voucher_version original ON original.id=v.reverses_id LEFT JOIN calculation_current current_basis ON current_basis.subject_id=v.voucher_subject_id LEFT JOIN calculation_publication current_publication ON current_publication.calculation_id=current_basis.calculation_id AND current_publication.voucher_id=v.voucher_id AND current_publication.posting_period=v.period WHERE v.close_period IS NOT NULL OR (EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM voucher_current a WHERE a.version_id=v.id) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM period_close p WHERE p.period=v.period))) SELECT s.*,c.subject_id AS basis_subject_id,c.kind AS basis_kind,c.fact_id AS basis_fact_id,c.period AS calculation_period,c.digest AS result_digest,EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM voucher_version x WHERE x.calculation_id=s.voucher_calculation_id AND x.reverses_id IS NOT NULL) AS replacement FROM selected s JOIN calculation c ON c.id=s.basis_calculation_id) j WHERE 1=1 AND j.period=? AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM voucher_line l WHERE l.version_id=j.id AND l.account IN (SELECT value FROM json_each(?)))) j JOIN close_reference r ON r.reference_id=j.id AND r.reference_type='voucher' AND r.close_period=j.close_period

SELECT s.*,c.subject_id AS basis_subject_id,c.kind AS basis_kind,c.fact_id AS basis_fact_id,c.period AS calculation_period,c.digest AS result_digest,EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM voucher_version x WHERE x.calculation_id=s.voucher_calculation_id AND x.reverses_id IS NOT NULL) AS replacement FROM selected s JOIN calculation c ON c.id=s.basis_calculation_id) j WHERE 1=1 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM voucher_line l WHERE l.version_id=j.id AND l.account IN (SELECT value FROM json_each(?)))), events AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT j.period,j.id event_id,j.number,j.basis_calculation_id AS INTEGER) effect_index,json_extract(b.value,'$.category') category,json_extract(b.value,'$.key') balance_key,json_extract(b.value,'$.amount') amount FROM events e,json_each(e.outcome,'$.balances') b OR v.close_period IS NULL) THEN coalesce(current_publication.calculation_id,v.calculation_id) ELSE v.calculation_id END AS basis_calculation_id FROM candidates v LEFT JOIN voucher_version original ON original.id=v.reverses_id LEFT JOIN calculation_current current_basis ON current_basis.subject_id=v.voucher_subject_id LEFT JOIN calculation_publication current_publication ON current_publication.calculation_id=current_basis.calculation_id AND current_publication.voucher_id=v.voucher_id AND current_publication.posting_period=v.period WHERE v.close_period IS NOT NULL OR (EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM voucher_current a WHERE a.version_id=v.id) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM period_close p WHERE p.period=v.period))) SELECT s.*,c.subject_id AS basis_subject_id,c.kind AS basis_kind,c.fact_id AS basis_fact_id,c.period AS calculation_period,c.digest AS result_digest,EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM voucher_version x WHERE x.calculation_id=s.voucher_calculation_id AND x.reverses_id IS NOT NULL) AS replacement FROM selected s JOIN calculation c ON c.id=s.basis_calculation_id) SELECT ?,v.period,v.id,l.line_no,v.voucher_calculation_id,v.basis_calculation_id,p.id,v.reverses_id,l.account,l.debit,l.credit,l.cashflow,c.kind,c.fact_id,c.period,c.subject_id,c.digest FROM selected v JOIN voucher_line l ON l.version_id=v.id JOIN calculation c ON c.id=v.basis_calculation_id LEFT JOIN calculation_publication p ON p.calculation_id=v.basis_calculation_id ORDER BY v.id,l.line_no

AS close_period FROM scoped_vouchers scoped CROSS JOIN voucher_version v ON v.id=scoped.id CROSS JOIN voucher n ON n.id=v.voucher_id CROSS JOIN calculation vc ON vc.id=v.calculation_id WHERE v.period<=?), selected AS (SELECT v.*,CASE WHEN v.close_period IS NOT NULL THEN 'close_manifest' ELSE 'current_publication' END AS selection_source,v.calculation_id AS voucher_calculation_id,CASE WHEN v.reverses_id IS NOT NULL THEN original.calculation_id WHEN (? OR v.close_period IS NULL) THEN coalesce((SELECT a.calculation_id FROM calculation_current a JOIN calculation_publication p ON p.calculation_id=a.calculation_id WHERE a.subject_id=v.voucher_subject_id AND p.voucher_id=v.voucher_id AND p.posting_period=v.period),v.calculation_id) ELSE v.calculation_id END AS basis_calculation_id FROM candidates v LEFT JOIN voucher_version original ON original.id=v.reverses_id WHERE v.close_period IS NOT NULL OR (EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM voucher_current a WHERE a.version_id=v.id) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM period_close p WHERE p.period=v.period))) SELECT s.*,c.subject_id AS basis_subject_id,c.kind AS basis_kind,c.fact_id AS basis_fact_id,c.period AS calculation_period,c.digest AS result_digest,EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM voucher_version x WHERE x.calculation_id=s.voucher_calculation_id AND x.reverses_id IS NOT NULL) AS replacement FROM selected s JOIN calculation c ON c.id=s.basis_calculation_id ) SELECT v.id version_id,v.period,v.basis_calculation_id calculation_id, v.reverses_id,v.close_period, l.line_no,l.account,l.debit,l.credit,l.cashflow,c.kind,c.fact_id, c.period calculation_period,c.subject_id calculation_subject_id FROM selected v JOIN voucher_line l ON l.version_id=v.id JOIN calculation c ON c.id=v.basis_calculation_id WHERE v.period>=? AND l.account IN (SELECT value FROM json_each(?))

decode_counter_definitions.stdlib_json_loads: Successful json.loads calls only; excludes Pydantic and pydantic-core JSON parsing.
decode_counter_definitions.typed_fact_json_decodes: Successful Fact.model_validate_json calls, including Store.fact/facts and other actual typed validations; repeated cache hits do not count.
decode_counter_definitions.raw_fact_json_decodes: Successful pydantic-core from_json calls on same-snapshot stored raw fact bytes.
decode_counter_definitions.calculation_result_json_decodes: Successful json.loads calls matching the byte length and SHA256 of calculation.outcome returned by instrumented SQL; raw outcomes are not retained, and results from other sources are outside this count.
decode_counter_definitions.adoption_accounting_slice_reads: Successful close_storage.read_accounting calls; nested adopted rows are counted separately and a QueryReads cache hit does not count.
decode_counter_definitions.adoption_section_reads: Successful close_storage.read_section calls for adopted_results; may overlap a full-manifest read.
decode_counter_definitions.full_close_manifest_decodes: Successful close_storage.decode_close calls; overlap with its section reads and must not be added to them.
decode_counter_definitions.material_original_parses: Successful materials.inspect_bytes calls on original bytes; successful inspection-cache hits do not count.

WITH requests AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT json_extract(value,'$[0]') AS slot,json_extract(value,'$[1]') AS kind,json_extract(value,'$[2]') AS key,json_extract(value,'$[3]') AS cutoff FROM json_each(?)), ids AS (SELECT q.slot,c.id FROM requests q CROSS JOIN calculation c ON c.id=substr(q.key,2) CROSS JOIN calculation_seal z ON z.calculation_id=c.id WHERE substr(q.key,1,1)='#' AND (q.kind='*' OR q.kind=c.kind) AND c.period<q.cutoff UNION ALL SELECT q.slot,c.id FROM requests q CROSS JOIN calculation c ON c.kind=q.kind CROSS JOIN calculation_current a ON a.calculation_id=c.id WHERE q.key='*' AND c.period<q.cutoff UNION ALL SELECT q.slot,c.id FROM requests q CROSS JOIN calculation_scope x ON x.kind=q.kind AND x.scope_key=q.key CROSS JOIN calculation_current a ON a.calculation_id=x.calculation_id CROSS JOIN calculation c ON c.id=a.calculation_id WHERE q.key<>'*' AND substr(q.key,1,1)<>'#' AND q.kind<>'*' AND c.period<q.cutoff UNION ALL SELECT q.slot,c.id FROM requests q CROSS JOIN calculation_scope x ON x.scope_key=q.key CROSS JOIN calculation_current a ON a.calculation_id=x.calculation_id CROSS JOIN calculation c ON c.id=a.calculation_id WHERE q.key<>'*' AND substr(q.key,1,1)<>'#' AND q.kind='*' AND c.period<q.cutoff) SELECT ids.slot,c.* FROM ids CROSS JOIN calculation c ON c.id=ids.id ORDER BY ids.slot,c.period,c.subject_id

SELECT DISTINCT json_extract(b.value,'$.key') FROM calculation_current a JOIN calculation c ON c.id=a.calculation_id,json_each(c.outcome,'$.balances') b WHERE c.period=? AND json_extract(b.value,'$.category')='bank'
SELECT json_extract(c.outcome,'$.values.bank_account_id') FROM calculation_current a JOIN calculation c ON c.id=a.calculation_id WHERE c.period=? AND c.kind='bank_reconciliation'

SELECT p.subject_id FROM pending p CROSS JOIN fact_current c CROSS JOIN fact_revision f CROSS JOIN subject s WHERE c.subject_id=p.subject_id AND f.id=c.fact_id AND s.id=c.subject_id AND s.kind IN(?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?) AND f.period<=? LIMIT 1
SELECT a.subject_id FROM fact_external_obligation f JOIN fact_current a ON a.fact_id=f.revision_id WHERE f.start_period<=? AND f.end_period>=?
SELECT a.fact_id FROM json_each(?) ids JOIN fact_current a ON a.subject_id=ids.value JOIN subject s ON s.id=a.subject_id WHERE s.kind='external_obligation'
SELECT p.subject_id FROM json_each(?) ids JOIN pending p ON p.subject_id=ids.value
SELECT p.calculation_id,p.sequence FROM calculation_publication p JOIN json_each(?) ids ON ids.value=p.calculation_id
SELECT j.* FROM jobs j WHERE j.id IN (SELECT job_id FROM job_reference WHERE start_period IS NOT NULL AND start_period<=? AND end_period>=?) ORDER BY j.rowid
SELECT DISTINCT subject_id FROM pending

SELECT f.revision_id,json_object('effective_from',f."effective_from",'effective_to',f."effective_to",'jurisdiction',f."jurisdiction",'period',CASE WHEN f."period" IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE CASE WHEN typeof(f."period")='integer' AND f."period" BETWEEN 0 AND 119987 THEN printf('%04d-%02d', f."period"/12+1, f."period"%12+1) ELSE 0 END END,'primary_source_url',f."primary_source_url",'rules',json(COALESCE((SELECT json_group_array(json_object('base_kind',c."base_kind",'code',c."code",'employee_rate',c."employee_rate",'employer_rate',c."employer_rate",'enabled',CASE WHEN c."enabled" IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE json(CASE WHEN (typeof(c."enabled") IN ('text','blob') AND length(c."enabled")>0) OR (typeof(c."enabled") NOT IN ('text','blob') AND c."enabled"!=0) THEN 'true' ELSE 'false' END) END,'maximum_base_fen',c."maximum_base_fen",'minimum_base_fen',c."minimum_base_fen",'rounding',c."rounding") ORDER BY c.item_no) FROM fact_payroll_contribution_policy_rules c WHERE c.revision_id=f.revision_id), '[]')),'version',f."version") FROM json_each(?) ids CROSS JOIN fact_payroll_contribution_policy f ON f.revision_id=ids.value
SELECT id,outcome FROM calculation WHERE id IN (SELECT value FROM json_each(?))

SELECT a.* FROM audit a WHERE a.id IN (SELECT r.audit_id FROM json_each(?) q JOIN audit_reference r ON r.source_type=json_extract(q.value,'$[0]') AND r.source_id=json_extract(q.value,'$[1]')) ORDER BY a.id
SELECT source_id,source_digest FROM read_index_source WHERE source_kind=? AND source_id IN (SELECT value FROM json_each(?))
SELECT audit_id,position,source_type,source_id FROM audit_reference WHERE audit_id IN (SELECT value FROM json_each(?))
PRAGMA data_version

decode_counter_definitions.stdlib_json_loads: Successful json.loads calls only; excludes Pydantic and pydantic-core JSON parsing.
decode_counter_definitions.typed_fact_json_decodes: Successful Fact.model_validate_json calls, including Store.fact/facts and other actual typed validations; repeated cache hits do not count.
decode_counter_definitions.raw_fact_json_decodes: Successful pydantic-core from_json calls on same-snapshot stored raw fact bytes.
decode_counter_definitions.calculation_result_json_decodes: Successful json.loads calls matching the byte length and SHA256 of calculation.outcome returned by instrumented SQL; raw outcomes are not retained, and results from other sources are outside this count.
decode_counter_definitions.adoption_accounting_slice_reads: Successful close_storage.read_accounting calls; nested adopted rows are counted separately and a QueryReads cache hit does not count.
decode_counter_definitions.adoption_section_reads: Successful close_storage.read_section calls for adopted_results; may overlap a full-manifest read.
decode_counter_definitions.full_close_manifest_decodes: Successful close_storage.decode_close calls; overlap with its section reads and must not be added to them.
decode_counter_definitions.material_original_parses: Successful materials.inspect_bytes calls on original bytes; successful inspection-cache hits do not count.

BEGIN
SELECT max(period) FROM period_close
SELECT rule_digest FROM material_close_rule WHERE period=?
SELECT 1 FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table' AND name='material_watch_root'
SELECT * FROM period_close WHERE period=?
SELECT content,root_digest FROM material_watch_root WHERE period=?
SELECT sequence,source,target_id,before_ref,after_ref FROM source_change WHERE sequence>? AND sequence<=? ORDER BY sequence

SELECT f.id,f.subject_id,s.kind,f.revision,(SELECT sequence FROM source_change WHERE source='fact' AND after_ref=f.id ORDER BY sequence LIMIT 1) FROM json_each(?) ids CROSS JOIN fact_revision f ON f.id=ids.value JOIN subject s ON s.id=f.subject_id
SELECT t.revision_id,t.evidence_digest FROM json_each(?) ids CROSS JOIN fact_material_source_v2 t ON t.revision_id=ids.value
SELECT t.revision_id,t.source_id FROM json_each(?) ids CROSS JOIN fact_material_period_allocation t ON t.revision_id=ids.value
SELECT t.revision_id,t.source_id FROM json_each(?) ids CROSS JOIN fact_material_resolution_v2 t ON t.revision_id=ids.value
SELECT t.revision_id,t.source_id FROM json_each(?) ids CROSS JOIN fact_material_group_resolution t ON t.revision_id=ids.value
SELECT DISTINCT l.subject_id FROM json_each(?) ids CROSS JOIN fact_material_resolution_v2_links l ON l.revision_id=ids.value
SELECT DISTINCT l.subject_id FROM json_each(?) ids CROSS JOIN fact_material_group_resolution_links l ON l.revision_id=ids.value
SELECT DISTINCT t.duplicate_source_id FROM json_each(?) ids CROSS JOIN fact_material_resolution_v2 t ON t.revision_id=ids.value WHERE t.duplicate_source_id IS NOT NULL
SELECT m.id,m.period,m.category FROM json_each(?) ids CROSS JOIN material_revision m ON m.id=ids.value
SELECT m.directory,m.content,m.content_digest FROM json_each(?) ids CROSS JOIN material_watch_directory m WHERE m.period=? AND m.directory=ids.value
SELECT b.bucket,b.content,b.content_digest FROM json_each(?) ids CROSS JOIN material_watch_bucket b WHERE b.period=? AND b.bucket=ids.value
SELECT p.* FROM period_close p WHERE p.period IN (SELECT value FROM json_each(?)) ORDER BY p.period
SELECT source_id,source_digest FROM read_index_source WHERE source_kind='close' AND source_id IN (SELECT value FROM json_each(?))
SELECT content,digest FROM close_storage_subroot WHERE period=? AND family=?
SELECT d.bucket,d.content,d.digest FROM json_each(?) requested CROSS JOIN close_storage_directory d ON d.bucket=requested.value AND d.period=? AND d.field=?
SELECT b.bucket,b.part,b.content,b.digest FROM json_each(?) requested CROSS JOIN close_storage_block b ON b.bucket=requested.value AND b.period=? AND b.field=?
SELECT c.subject_id,c.fact_id FROM fact_current c JOIN subject s ON s.id=c.subject_id WHERE s.kind=?
SELECT c.fact_id FROM fact_current c JOIN subject s ON s.id=c.subject_id WHERE s.kind=? ORDER BY c.subject_id
SELECT f.* FROM json_each(?) ids JOIN fact_material_source_v2 f ON f.revision_id=ids.value

WITH RECURSIVE sources(source_id) AS (SELECT min(source_id) FROM fact_material_period_allocation UNION ALL SELECT (SELECT min(source_id) FROM fact_material_period_allocation WHERE source_id>sources.source_id) FROM sources WHERE source_id IS NOT NULL) SELECT c.fact_id FROM sources CROSS JOIN fact_material_period_allocation t ON t.source_id=sources.source_id CROSS JOIN fact_current c ON c.fact_id=t.revision_id CROSS JOIN subject s ON s.id=c.subject_id WHERE s.kind=? AND sources.source_id NOT IN (SELECT value FROM json_each(?)) ORDER BY c.subject_id

SELECT f.revision_id,json_object('entries',json(COALESCE((SELECT json_group_array(json_object('basis',c."basis",'basis_evidence_digest',c."basis_evidence_digest",'basis_excerpt',c."basis_excerpt",'basis_location',c."basis_location",'column',c."column",'first_row',c."first_row",'last_row',c."last_row",'location',c."location",'recognition_period',CASE WHEN c."recognition_period" IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE CASE WHEN typeof(c."recognition_period")='integer' AND c."recognition_period" BETWEEN 0 AND 119987 THEN printf('%04d-%02d', c."recognition_period"/12+1, c."recognition_period"%12+1) ELSE 0 END END,'sheet',c."sheet") ORDER BY c.item_no) FROM fact_material_period_allocation_entries c WHERE c.revision_id=f.revision_id), '[]')),'period',CASE WHEN f."period" IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE CASE WHEN typeof(f."period")='integer' AND f."period" BETWEEN 0 AND 119987 THEN printf('%04d-%02d', f."period"/12+1, f."period"%12+1) ELSE 0 END END,'source_fact_id',f."source_fact_id",'source_id',f."source_id") FROM json_each(?) ids CROSS JOIN fact_material_period_allocation f ON f.revision_id=ids.value

WITH RECURSIVE sources(source_id) AS (SELECT min(source_id) FROM fact_material_group_resolution UNION ALL SELECT (SELECT min(source_id) FROM fact_material_group_resolution WHERE source_id>sources.source_id) FROM sources WHERE source_id IS NOT NULL) SELECT c.fact_id FROM sources CROSS JOIN fact_material_group_resolution t ON t.source_id=sources.source_id CROSS JOIN fact_current c ON c.fact_id=t.revision_id CROSS JOIN subject s ON s.id=c.subject_id WHERE s.kind=? AND sources.source_id NOT IN (SELECT value FROM json_each(?)) ORDER BY c.subject_id

WITH RECURSIVE sources(source_id) AS (SELECT min(source_id) FROM fact_material_resolution_v2 UNION ALL SELECT (SELECT min(source_id) FROM fact_material_resolution_v2 WHERE source_id>sources.source_id) FROM sources WHERE source_id IS NOT NULL) SELECT c.fact_id FROM sources CROSS JOIN fact_material_resolution_v2 t ON t.source_id=sources.source_id CROSS JOIN fact_current c ON c.fact_id=t.revision_id CROSS JOIN subject s ON s.id=c.subject_id WHERE s.kind=? AND sources.source_id NOT IN (SELECT value FROM json_each(?)) ORDER BY c.subject_id

SELECT f.revision_id,json_object('amount_fen',f."amount_fen",'duplicate_location',f."duplicate_location",'duplicate_source_id',f."duplicate_source_id",'links',json(COALESCE((SELECT json_group_array(json_object('amount_fen',c."amount_fen",'amount_field',c."amount_field",'calculation_id',c."calculation_id",'fact_id',c."fact_id",'fact_kind',c."fact_kind",'recognition_period',CASE WHEN c."recognition_period" IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE CASE WHEN typeof(c."recognition_period")='integer' AND c."recognition_period" BETWEEN 0 AND 119987 THEN printf('%04d-%02d', c."recognition_period"/12+1, c."recognition_period"%12+1) ELSE 0 END END,'subject_id',c."subject_id") ORDER BY c.item_no) FROM fact_material_resolution_v2_links c WHERE c.revision_id=f.revision_id), '[]')),'location',f."location",'non_accounting_reason',f."non_accounting_reason",'period',CASE WHEN f."period" IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE CASE WHEN typeof(f."period")='integer' AND f."period" BETWEEN 0 AND 119987 THEN printf('%04d-%02d', f."period"/12+1, f."period"%12+1) ELSE 0 END END,'reason',f."reason",'recognition_period',CASE WHEN f."recognition_period" IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE CASE WHEN typeof(f."recognition_period")='integer' AND f."recognition_period" BETWEEN 0 AND 119987 THEN printf('%04d-%02d', f."recognition_period"/12+1, f."recognition_period"%12+1) ELSE 0 END END,'source_fact_id',f."source_fact_id",'source_id',f."source_id",'treatment',f."treatment") FROM json_each(?) ids CROSS JOIN fact_material_resolution_v2 f ON f.revision_id=ids.value

WITH current_inventory AS (SELECT m.* FROM material_revision m WHERE m.id=(SELECT max(n.id) FROM material_revision n WHERE n.period=m.period AND n.category=m.category)) SELECT c.*,i.evidence_digest item_digest FROM current_inventory c LEFT JOIN material_item i ON i.inventory_id=c.id WHERE c.period IN (SELECT value FROM json_each(?)) OR (? IS NOT NULL AND c.period<=?) ORDER BY c.period,c.category,i.evidence_digest

SELECT ids.value requested_subject_id,f.fact_id current_fact_id,c.id,c.fact_id,c.period,CASE WHEN json_type(c.outcome,'$.values')='object' THEN (SELECT json_group_object(j.key,json(c.outcome->j.fullkey)) FROM json_each(c.outcome,'$.values') j WHERE substr(j.key,-4)='_fen') ELSE json_extract(c.outcome,'$.values') END result_values FROM json_each(?) ids LEFT JOIN fact_current f ON f.subject_id=ids.value LEFT JOIN calculation_current a ON a.subject_id=f.subject_id LEFT JOIN calculation c ON c.id=a.calculation_id ORDER BY ids.value

SELECT f.revision_id,json_object('accounting_gross_salary_fen',f."accounting_gross_salary_fen",'contribution_basis',f."contribution_basis",'contribution_policy_id',f."contribution_policy_id",'employee_id',f."employee_id",'expense_class',f."expense_class",'income_tax_policy_id',f."income_tax_policy_id",'other_legal_deduction_fen',f."other_legal_deduction_fen",'period',CASE WHEN f."period" IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE CASE WHEN typeof(f."period")='integer' AND f."period" BETWEEN 0 AND 119987 THEN printf('%04d-%02d', f."period"/12+1, f."period"%12+1) ELSE 0 END END,'profile_id',f."profile_id",'special_additional_deduction_fen',f."special_additional_deduction_fen",'tax_exempt_income_fen',f."tax_exempt_income_fen",'tax_relief_fen',f."tax_relief_fen",'tax_reported_salary_fen',f."tax_reported_salary_fen") FROM json_each(?) ids CROSS JOIN fact_payroll f ON f.revision_id=ids.value

SELECT f.revision_id,json_object('actual_date',f."actual_date",'allocations',json(COALESCE((SELECT json_group_array(json_object('amount_fen',c."amount_fen",'obligation',c."obligation",'recipient_id',c."recipient_id",'source_id',c."source_id",'source_kind',c."source_kind") ORDER BY c.item_no) FROM fact_payment_allocations c WHERE c.revision_id=f.revision_id), '[]')),'amount_fen',f."amount_fen",'bank_account_id',f."bank_account_id",'counterparty_id',f."counterparty_id",'direction',f."direction",'payment_method',f."payment_method",'period',CASE WHEN f."period" IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE CASE WHEN typeof(f."period")='integer' AND f."period" BETWEEN 0 AND 119987 THEN printf('%04d-%02d', f."period"/12+1, f."period"%12+1) ELSE 0 END END) FROM json_each(?) ids CROSS JOIN fact_payment f ON f.revision_id=ids.value

SELECT f.revision_id,json_object('customer_id',f."customer_id",'exemption_eligible',CASE WHEN f."exemption_eligible" IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE json(CASE WHEN (typeof(f."exemption_eligible") IN ('text','blob') AND length(f."exemption_eligible")>0) OR (typeof(f."exemption_eligible") NOT IN ('text','blob') AND f."exemption_eligible"!=0) THEN 'true' ELSE 'false' END) END,'fulfillment_date',f."fulfillment_date",'gross_fen',f."gross_fen",'period',CASE WHEN f."period" IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE CASE WHEN typeof(f."period")='integer' AND f."period" BETWEEN 0 AND 119987 THEN printf('%04d-%02d', f."period"/12+1, f."period"%12+1) ELSE 0 END END,'tax_obligation_date',f."tax_obligation_date",'tax_obligation_period',CASE WHEN f."tax_obligation_period" IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE CASE WHEN typeof(f."tax_obligation_period")='integer' AND f."tax_obligation_period" BETWEEN 0 AND 119987 THEN printf('%04d-%02d', f."tax_obligation_period"/12+1, f."tax_obligation_period"%12+1) ELSE 0 END END,'vat_policy_id',f."vat_policy_id") FROM json_each(?) ids CROSS JOIN fact_service_sale f ON f.revision_id=ids.value

SELECT f.revision_id,json_object('amount_fen',f."amount_fen",'counterparty_id',f."counterparty_id",'creditor_kind',f."creditor_kind",'expense_class',f."expense_class",'period',CASE WHEN f."period" IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE CASE WHEN typeof(f."period")='integer' AND f."period" BETWEEN 0 AND 119987 THEN printf('%04d-%02d', f."period"/12+1, f."period"%12+1) ELSE 0 END END) FROM json_each(?) ids CROSS JOIN fact_expense f ON f.revision_id=ids.value
SELECT f.* FROM json_each(?) ids JOIN fact_managed_reserve_refund f ON f.revision_id=ids.value
SELECT f.* FROM json_each(?) ids JOIN fact_managed_reserve_expense f ON f.revision_id=ids.value

SELECT f.revision_id,json_object('acquisition_basis',f."acquisition_basis",'acquisition_date',f."acquisition_date",'asset_id',f."asset_id",'asset_type',f."asset_type",'cost_fen',f."cost_fen",'period',CASE WHEN f."period" IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE CASE WHEN typeof(f."period")='integer' AND f."period" BETWEEN 0 AND 119987 THEN printf('%04d-%02d', f."period"/12+1, f."period"%12+1) ELSE 0 END END,'project_sources',json(COALESCE((SELECT json_group_array(json_object('amount_fen',c."amount_fen",'source_id',c."source_id") ORDER BY c.item_no) FROM fact_asset_project_sources c WHERE c.revision_id=f.revision_id), '[]')),'supplier_id',f."supplier_id") FROM json_each(?) ids CROSS JOIN fact_asset f ON f.revision_id=ids.value

SELECT f.revision_id,json_object('actual_date',f."actual_date",'agreement_id',f."agreement_id",'bank_account_id',f."bank_account_id",'period',CASE WHEN f."period" IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE CASE WHEN typeof(f."period")='integer' AND f."period" BETWEEN 0 AND 119987 THEN printf('%04d-%02d', f."period"/12+1, f."period"%12+1) ELSE 0 END END,'principal_fen',f."principal_fen") FROM json_each(?) ids CROSS JOIN fact_loan_drawdown f ON f.revision_id=ids.value
SELECT f.* FROM json_each(?) ids JOIN fact_tax_assessment f ON f.revision_id=ids.value
SELECT p.subject_id FROM json_each(?) ids JOIN pending p ON p.subject_id=ids.value

sql.statement: SELECT s.evidence_digest,s.specification,e.content FROM fact_material_source_v2 s JOIN fact_current c ON c.fact_id=s.revision_id JOIN fact_revision f ON f.id=s.revision_id JOIN evidence e ON e.digest=unhex(s.evidence_digest) WHERE f.subject_id=? AND f.id=?
SELECT h.sequence,(SELECT max(sequence) FROM source_change) FROM source_change_head h WHERE id=1
SELECT s.id,s.kind FROM json_each(?) ids JOIN subject s ON s.id=ids.value
SELECT s.fact_id FROM fact_seal s JOIN json_each(?) ids ON ids.value=s.fact_id
SELECT e.fact_id,e.evidence_digest FROM fact_evidence e JOIN json_each(?) ids ON ids.value=e.fact_id
BEGIN
SELECT * FROM period_close WHERE period<=? ORDER BY period DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT storage_digest FROM close_storage_root WHERE period=?
SELECT source_digest FROM read_index_source WHERE source_kind='close' AND source_id=?
SELECT company_id,database_id FROM identity WHERE id=1
SELECT * FROM duplicate_freeze_root WHERE period=?
SELECT sequence,source,target_id,before_ref,after_ref FROM source_change WHERE sequence>? AND sequence<=? ORDER BY sequence
SELECT ids.value FROM json_each(?) ids LEFT JOIN subject s ON s.id=ids.value WHERE s.kind IS NULL OR s.kind IN ('material_source_v2','material_resolution_v2')

SELECT f.id,f.subject_id,f.revision,(SELECT sequence FROM source_change WHERE source='fact' AND after_ref=f.id ORDER BY sequence LIMIT 1) FROM json_each(?) ids CROSS JOIN fact_revision f ON f.id=ids.value
SELECT DISTINCT f.subject_id FROM json_each(?) ids JOIN fact_material_resolution_v2_links l ON l.revision_id=ids.value JOIN fact_revision f ON f.id=l.fact_id
SELECT d.id,d.selected_fact_id,f.subject_id FROM json_each(?) ids LEFT JOIN business_duplicate_check d ON d.id=ids.value LEFT JOIN fact_revision f ON f.id=d.selected_fact_id

SELECT f.id,f.subject_id,s.kind,c.subject_id FROM fact_revision f INDEXED BY fact_period CROSS JOIN fact_current c ON c.fact_id=f.id CROSS JOIN subject s ON s.id=f.subject_id WHERE f.period>? AND f.period<=?

SELECT ids.value,s.kind,c.fact_id,f.subject_id,f.period FROM json_each(?) ids LEFT JOIN subject s ON s.id=ids.value LEFT JOIN fact_current c ON c.subject_id=ids.value LEFT JOIN fact_revision f ON f.id=c.fact_id

SELECT l.fact_id,r.revision_id resolution_fact_id,r.source_id,r.source_fact_id,r.location,s.evidence_digest FROM fact_material_resolution_v2_links l JOIN fact_current c ON c.fact_id=l.revision_id JOIN fact_material_resolution_v2 r ON r.revision_id=c.fact_id JOIN fact_material_source_v2 s ON s.revision_id=r.source_fact_id WHERE l.fact_id IN (SELECT value FROM json_each(?)) AND r.treatment='recognize' ORDER BY l.fact_id,r.source_id,r.location

decode_counter_definitions.stdlib_json_loads: Successful json.loads calls only; excludes Pydantic and pydantic-core JSON parsing.
decode_counter_definitions.typed_fact_json_decodes: Successful Fact.model_validate_json calls, including Store.fact/facts and other actual typed validations; repeated cache hits do not count.
decode_counter_definitions.raw_fact_json_decodes: Successful pydantic-core from_json calls on same-snapshot stored raw fact bytes.
decode_counter_definitions.calculation_result_json_decodes: Successful json.loads calls matching the byte length and SHA256 of calculation.outcome returned by instrumented SQL; raw outcomes are not retained, and results from other sources are outside this count.
decode_counter_definitions.adoption_accounting_slice_reads: Successful close_storage.read_accounting calls; nested adopted rows are counted separately and a QueryReads cache hit does not count.
decode_counter_definitions.adoption_section_reads: Successful close_storage.read_section calls for adopted_results; may overlap a full-manifest read.
decode_counter_definitions.full_close_manifest_decodes: Successful close_storage.decode_close calls; overlap with its section reads and must not be added to them.
decode_counter_definitions.material_original_parses: Successful materials.inspect_bytes calls on original bytes; successful inspection-cache hits do not count.

WITH requests AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT json_extract(value,'$[0]') AS slot,json_extract(value,'$[1]') AS kind,json_extract(value,'$[2]') AS key,json_extract(value,'$[3]') AS cutoff FROM json_each(?)), ids AS (SELECT q.slot,c.id FROM requests q CROSS JOIN calculation c ON c.id=substr(q.key,2) CROSS JOIN calculation_seal z ON z.calculation_id=c.id WHERE substr(q.key,1,1)='#' AND (q.kind='*' OR q.kind=c.kind) AND c.period<q.cutoff UNION ALL SELECT q.slot,c.id FROM requests q CROSS JOIN calculation c ON c.kind=q.kind CROSS JOIN calculation_current a ON a.calculation_id=c.id WHERE q.key='*' AND c.period<q.cutoff UNION ALL SELECT q.slot,c.id FROM requests q CROSS JOIN calculation_scope x ON x.kind=q.kind AND x.scope_key=q.key CROSS JOIN calculation_current a ON a.calculation_id=x.calculation_id CROSS JOIN calculation c ON c.id=a.calculation_id WHERE q.key<>'*' AND substr(q.key,1,1)<>'#' AND q.kind<>'*' AND c.period<q.cutoff UNION ALL SELECT q.slot,c.id FROM requests q CROSS JOIN calculation_scope x ON x.scope_key=q.key CROSS JOIN calculation_current a ON a.calculation_id=x.calculation_id CROSS JOIN calculation c ON c.id=a.calculation_id WHERE q.key<>'*' AND substr(q.key,1,1)<>'#' AND q.kind='*' AND c.period<q.cutoff) SELECT ids.slot,c.* FROM ids CROSS JOIN calculation c ON c.id=ids.id ORDER BY ids.slot,c.period,c.subject_id

WITH selected AS (WITH candidates AS (SELECT v.*,n.number,vc.subject_id AS voucher_subject_id,NULL AS close_period FROM voucher_version v CROSS JOIN voucher n ON n.id=v.voucher_id CROSS JOIN calculation vc ON vc.id=v.calculation_id WHERE v.period<=? AND v.period=?), selected AS (SELECT v.*,CASE WHEN v.close_period IS NOT NULL THEN 'close_manifest' ELSE 'current_publication' END AS selection_source,v.calculation_id AS voucher_calculation_id,CASE WHEN v.reverses_id IS NOT NULL THEN original.calculation_id WHEN (? OR v.close_period IS NULL) THEN coalesce(current_publication.calculation_id,v.calculation_id) ELSE v.calculation_id END AS basis_calculation_id FROM candidates v LEFT JOIN voucher_version original ON original.id=v.reverses_id LEFT JOIN calculation_current current_basis ON current_basis.subject_id=v.voucher_subject_id LEFT JOIN calculation_publication current_publication ON current_publication.calculation_id=current_basis.calculation_id AND current_publication.voucher_id=v.voucher_id AND current_publication.posting_period=v.period WHERE v.close_period IS NOT NULL OR (EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM voucher_current a WHERE a.version_id=v.id) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM period_close p WHERE p.period=v.period))) SELECT s.*,c.subject_id AS basis_subject_id,c.kind AS basis_kind,c.fact_id AS basis_fact_id,c.period AS calculation_period,c.digest AS result_digest,EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM voucher_version x WHERE x.calculation_id=s.voucher_calculation_id AND x.reverses_id IS NOT NULL) AS replacement FROM selected s JOIN calculation c ON c.id=s.basis_calculation_id) SELECT ?,v.period,v.id,l.line_no,v.voucher_calculation_id,v.basis_calculation_id,p.id,v.reverses_id,l.account,l.debit,l.credit,l.cashflow,c.kind,c.fact_id,c.period,c.subject_id,c.digest FROM selected v JOIN voucher_line l ON l.version_id=v.id JOIN calculation c ON c.id=v.basis_calculation_id LEFT JOIN calculation_publication p ON p.calculation_id=v.basis_calculation_id ORDER BY v.id,l.line_no

WITH selected AS (WITH scoped_vouchers AS (SELECT value AS id FROM json_each(?)), candidates AS (SELECT v.*,n.number,vc.subject_id AS voucher_subject_id,(SELECT min(r.close_period) FROM close_reference r WHERE r.reference_type='voucher' AND r.reference_id=v.id AND r.close_period<=?) AS close_period FROM scoped_vouchers scoped CROSS JOIN voucher_version v ON v.id=scoped.id CROSS JOIN voucher n ON n.id=v.voucher_id CROSS JOIN calculation vc ON vc.id=v.calculation_id WHERE v.period<=?), selected AS (SELECT v.*,CASE WHEN v.close_period IS NOT NULL THEN 'close_manifest' ELSE 'current_publication' END AS selection_source,v.calculation_id AS voucher_calculation_id,CASE WHEN v.reverses_id IS NOT NULL THEN original.calculation_id WHEN (? OR v.close_period IS NULL) THEN coalesce((SELECT a.calculation_id FROM calculation_current a JOIN calculation_publication p ON p.calculation_id=a.calculation_id WHERE a.subject_id=v.voucher_subject_id AND p.voucher_id=v.voucher_id AND p.posting_period=v.period),v.calculation_id) ELSE v.calculation_id END AS basis_calculation_id FROM candidates v LEFT JOIN voucher_version original ON original.id=v.reverses_id WHERE v.close_period IS NOT NULL OR (EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM voucher_current a WHERE a.version_id=v.id) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM period_close p WHERE p.period=v.period))) SELECT s.*,c.subject_id AS basis_subject_id,c.kind AS basis_kind,c.fact_id AS basis_fact_id,c.period AS calculation_period,c.digest AS result_digest,EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM voucher_version x WHERE x.calculation_id=s.voucher_calculation_id AND x.reverses_id IS NOT NULL) AS replacement FROM selected s JOIN calculation c ON c.id=s.basis_calculation_id ) SELECT v.id version_id,v.period,v.basis_calculation_id calculation_id, v.reverses_id,v.close_period, l.line_no,l.account,l.debit,l.credit,l.cashflow,c.kind,c.fact_id, c.period calculation_period,c.subject_id calculation_subject_id FROM selected v JOIN voucher_line l ON l.version_id=v.id JOIN calculation c ON c.id=v.basis_calculation_id WHERE v.period>=? AND l.account IN (SELECT value FROM json_each(?))

measurement_scope: Instrumented diagnostic work, not page latency. SQLite VM steps are sampled in hundreds; returned bytes are values delivered to Python, not disk I/O. Per-process tracemalloc peaks include instrumentation and cannot be summed as simultaneous RSS. Connection validation before Store-bound queries is outside measure_work; the parallel guard's own SQL is counted separately.
